Container.Name: Cerious-AASM
Container.Overview:
Cerious AASM is a self-hosted Ark: Survival Ascended server manager with a web interface. It manages dedicated ARK server installations using SteamCMD/Proton and provides server configuration and management from your browser.
This Unraid template uses host networking so game, query, peer, and RCON ports can be managed directly on the Unraid host without maintaining large Docker port mappings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ARK ASA Ark Survival Ascended server manager AASM SteamCMD Proton game server
Container.Requires: An x86-64 Unraid server with Docker enabled. Internet access is required to pull the container image and download/update dedicated server files. Host networking is used for game-server connectivity.

Config.Name: AASM Data
Config.Description: Persistent Cerious AASM application data and managed server data.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used by the Cerious AASM web interface. With host networking this port is opened directly on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Cerious AASM web authentication password. Set this when authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: Network Mode Indicator
Config.Description: Tells AASM that it is running with host networking so its firewall UI can present host-level networking guidance.
